summary_text: Long-acting injectable for plaque psoriasis (ORKA-001) helped 63% of patients achieve complete skin clearance in mid-stage trial, announced Apr 27 2026. Stock was up 32.12% premarket that Monday after 1.9% Friday rally. Updated blood exposure analysis supports once-per-year dosing potential. Data from EVERLAST-A Phase 2a trial of ORKA-001 (half-life extended IL-23p19 mAb) for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis. Positioned vs Skyrizi and Bimzelx with fewer injections.
